helpers.name: Vlasov.diagonalCorrection_eq
helpers.one_line_math: Pure inner-product algebra atop convolveFunctionMeasure_empiricalSpatial_eq: (1/N) Σᵢ ⟨-(1/N)•Σ_{j≠i} ∇W(Xᵢ-Xⱼ), ∇ᵥφᵢ⟩ = -(1/N) Σᵢ ⟨(∇W*ρ_t^N)(Xᵢ), ∇ᵥφᵢ⟩ + (1/N²) Σᵢ ⟨∇W(0), ∇ᵥφᵢ⟩. Method: extend Σ_{j≠i} to Σⱼ via Finset.sum_ite_ne (the j=i summand is gradW(0)), inner_sub_left distributes the inner over the subtraction, the leading −(1/N) acceleration coefficient flips the diagonal-term sign to +. NOTE: original statement had a sign bug (− instead of +) on the diagonal term; corrected in this revision after derivation review.

helpers.name: Vlasov.diagonalCorrection_bound
helpers.one_line_math: Pointwise bound on the diagonal correction: |(1/N²) Σᵢ ⟨∇W(0), ∇ᵥφ(zᵢ)⟩| ≤ (1/N) · sup_x ‖∇W(x)‖ · sup_z ‖∇ᵥφ(z)‖, via Cauchy-Schwarz on each summand and (1/N²)·N = 1/N counting. **Requires** `BddAbove (range ‖gradW·‖)` and `BddAbove (range ‖gradVφ·‖)` — without these, the conditional supremum on ℝ returns junk value 0. Absolute value on the bound makes the sign correction in diagonalCorrection_eq irrelevant here; deps[] cleared (not actually dependent on the equality form).
